record.hypothesis: Across all four datasets, replace dot-product compatibility with jointly trained diagonal bilinear compatibility: score(h,e)=sum(h*g*e), with one trainable gain vector g initialized to ones per category model. This starts at incumbent scores and may calibrate recurrent dimensions against unit-normalized candidate embeddings with negligible added computation. Preserve GRU recurrence, input features, embedding parameterization, sequence selection, readout, loss and optimizer. Update the predictor writer and checkpoint loading for the gain parameter.

category_rationales.rationale: Introduce jointly trained diagonal bilinear compatibility with a gain vector initialized to ones. This preserves initial scores while allowing recurrent dimensions to learn different scoring weights in each category model. Keep embeddings, GRU recurrence, readout, loss and optimizer unchanged.
